question: If the focal length of a lens is -25 cm, the power of the lens will be:
solution:
The correct answer is __**-4D**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The power of a lens (P) is calculated using the formula P = 1/f, where f is the focal length in meters.
 
• Given the focal length (f) is -25 cm, which is -0.25 meters (since 1 cm = 0.01 meters).
 
• Substituting the value into the formula: P = 1 / -0.25 = -4 Diopters (D).
 
• A negative power indicates that the lens is a diverging (concave) lens.
